brief: wide cinematic painting of an artist's studio and critic's workbench at golden hour: two framed paintings of the same mountain landscape propped side by side on twin easels for comparison, a brass jeweller's loupe and a painter's palette of mixed oil colours on the bench, a round paper colour wheel, a glazed celadon ceramic vase, a small glowing monitor showing a pixel-art dragon sprite, charcoal figure sketches pinned to the wall, a clay sculpture half under a cloth, warm window light, deep blue-green shadows, painterly oil texture, rich detail, no readable text, no letters, no logos
notes: Round robin of four seeds, each pair judged blind in both orders in separate calls. Seed 202 won all three of its pairs in both orders. 303 v 404 flipped between orders and is shown as a tie. Brief misses common to all four: no sculpture under a cloth.
